meta.title: bInference Agent: your own AI agent on BNB Smart Chain
meta.description: An open-source AI agent that runs on your Mac and works on BNB Smart Chain day and night. It reads, researches, watches and trades, and never moves a coin without your tap.
gate.label: Tap to wake the agent
hero.title:
You tapped

Now I am awake.
hero.lead: I am your agent. My home is your Mac, and I work on BNB Smart Chain day and night: I read, I research, I watch, I trade. I never move a coin without that tap.
takeover.readLine: The chain, the charts, X and any web page. All day.
takeover.checkLine: The token, a test sale, the best route and the fee.
takeover.askLine: One card on Telegram. Then I wait for you.
day.title: A day with me.
day.example: an example day · scroll to move the clock
day.night: Read 214 new launches. Three passed my checks. I saved them for you.
day.morning: Wrote your morning summary: positions, profit and loss, what moved.
day.alert: CAKE crossed your alert. I drafted a trade. I am waiting for your tap.
day.noon: Watched your stop-loss on CAKE all morning. The price held.
day.evening: Read 40 posts about BNB staking. The short answer is in your chat.
tools.title: What I can use.
tools.chainText: Any contract, wallet or transaction on BSC.
tools.walletsText: Keys in a secure enclave. Limits you set.
tools.venuesText: KyberSwap, OKX, Flap, Genius.fun and Brew.
tools.browserText: X and any web page, read before you decide.
tools.terminalText: Commands and files on your Mac, walled off from my own keys.
tools.clockText: Schedules, alerts and orders that wait for the moment.
tools.memoryText: Your strategy, your notes, and the skills I learn.
tools.helpersText: Side tasks I hand to helpers, and whose reports I read.

install.title: Take me home.
